card.text: Explore Pallene with Cassini imagery and its measured shape.

introduction.text: Pallene is a small, elongated moon between Mimas and Enceladus. Cassini discovered it in 2004 and later resolved its smooth-looking outline. A faint dust ring follows its orbit around Saturn.

normal.title: ISS clear-filter image
normal.summary: Only about 8 × 12 source pixels resolve the moon. Brightness shows coarse detail; the gray grid marks unobserved surface.
